2026-10-09 07:59:59.743017 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743035 | controller |
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743040 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743044 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743048 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743052 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743066 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-10-09 07:59:59.743069 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
